meta.name: security-research
meta.description: Team Mode security research skill. Orchestrates 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit a codebase in parallel, prove exploitability, classify root causes, and calibrate severity by actual exploitability. Use for security review, vulnerability research, exploitability audit, pre-release security check, threat model validation, and `/security-research`. Triggers: 'security-research', 'security research', 'security review', 'vulnerability audit', 'exploitability audit', '보안 리뷰', '취약점 감사'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行审计代码库，发现漏洞并验证可利用性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对代码库进行深度安全审查并验证漏洞可利用性
copy.tagline_en: Audit codebases in parallel, find vulnerabilities and verify exploitability
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need deep security review of codebases with exploitability validation

howto.what: 它会拉起 3 名漏洞猎手和 2 名 PoC 工程师,并行审计你给的代码库;为候选漏洞构建最简 PoC 验证能否利用,按实际可利用性定级,最后产出带判定(PASS/PASS WITH FINDINGS/BLOCK)的分级报告。
howto.when: 当你提到「security review」「vulnerability audit」等关键词,或输入 /security-research 时接管;前提是 team-mode 工具可用,并且有具体审计目标。没有目标时默认审计当前仓库与分支差异。

say.text: 用 security-research 审计当前分支相对上游的改动
say.note: 会拉起 5 人团队并行审计并给出判定。

say.text: 对 src/auth 做一次可利用性审计
say.note: 猎手先找候选,再由 PoC 工程师验证或推翻。

say.text: 跑一次发布前安全检查,不要做破坏性测试
say.note: 只用本地 PoC 或静态证明,并列出残余风险。

howto.what_en: It runs 3 vulnerability hunters and 2 PoC engineers to audit your codebase in parallel, builds minimal PoCs to test exploitability, calibrates severity by real exploitability, and returns a graded report with a PASS/BLOCK verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers on keywords like 'security review' or 'vulnerability audit', or the /security-research command. Requires team-mode tools and a concrete target; otherwise it audits the current repo.

say_en.text: Run security-research on the current branch diff
say_en.note: Starts a 5-member team and returns a verdict.
Hunters find candidates, PoC engineers verify them.

say_en.text: Do a pre-release security check, no destructive tests
say_en.note: Uses local PoCs or static proof and lists residual risk.
